description:
## Settings

* Hushfeed settings now opens with a live status card that shows the installed Hushfeed and TikTok versions. Diagnostics is one tap away.
* Feed filter, Privacy and Screen time now have direct buttons under Search.
* The new controls expose native button roles, visible focus and press feedback, and touch targets of at least 48 dp.
* The overview stacks cleanly when Android text is enlarged.

## Compatibility

Hushfeed v0.47.0 targets TikTok 47.0.3. All 91 patches applied to the retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3, 46.9.3 and 47.0.3 fixtures with no manifest changes. The full build was installed over the existing signed-in TikTok app on the S22 test phone with the same signing key, and the new overview and all four routes were exercised there.

Use the TikTok 47.0.3 universal APK. Keep your existing Morphe signing key when updating so Android can preserve TikTok's app data.
